title: NASA TechLeap Prize：Orbital Clarity Challenge
region: 美国 / 线上 / 资格受限

en.title: NASA TechLeap Prize: Orbital Clarity Challenge
en.timezone: 5:00 PM ET; registration is required by 5:00 PM ET on October 28
en.eligibility: Individuals must be U.S. citizens or permanent residents aged 18+; organizations must be incorporated and primarily based in the U.S.; teams need an eligible lead, with foreign members subject to the official restrictions
